content: I recently purchased this foam mattress hoping for comfort and support, but it has been a disappointment from day one. Firstly, the odor was overwhelming; even after airing it out for over a week, the chemical smell lingered. I expected the mattress to be firm yet supportive, but instead, it’s uncomfortably soft and saggy, causing back pain every morning. It also retains heat like no other, making it unbearable to sleep on during warmer nights. The edges are poorly reinforced, causing you to roll off if you get too close. Within just a few months, noticeable indentations have formed where I sleep, which is frustrating considering the price. Customer service was unhelpful when I reached out, offering no viable solutions or return options. Overall, this purchase has been a costly mistake, and I wouldn’t recommend this mattress to anyone.
